title: Hynek provided Bennewitz's computer; Doty psyop

tellings.quote: then J. Allen Hynek also, I just learned this, he I think provided the laptop to Paul Bennewitz where Paul Bennewitz was receiving alien signals for He's being sci-op by Rick Doty, who's an Air Force officer.

plain: In the 1980s, according to Michels, the astronomer J. Allen Hynek, long the US Air Force's scientific adviser on UFOs, supplied the computer that an Albuquerque man named Paul Bennewitz used to pick up what he believed were alien signals. At the same time, Michels says, Bennewitz was the target of a psychological operation, a deliberate campaign of deception, run by an Air Force officer named Rick Doty. Michels says he had only just learned this and hedges it with "I think"; if true, it would put a respected scientist close to a government effort to mislead a UFO believer.
